verdict.rationale: ChatGPT ships an official Codex CLI with documented commands (--search, --cd, /memories, /fast, MCP config via config.toml, codex-security bulk-scan), and the llms.txt probe confirms 'Codex CLI' as a first-party interface for building and automating dev workflows, satisfying the AI-native official CLI story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on community verification of the CLI itself, since community evidence only covers the general ChatGPT web product, not Codex CLI usage.
